facts.fact: The INCEIT page says C-DAC will set up a 5-node PARAM cluster (17.7 TF, including one NVIDIA Tesla V100 GPU node) to be deployed at NUST, Windhoek, Namibia.

systems.platform: C-DAC PARAM cluster, Dell PowerEdge, 1 NVIDIA Tesla V100
systems.owner: Namibia University of Science and Technology (INCEIT)
